summary.en: If you live in Japan, are aged 20 to 59 and are not in an employer's pension (Kosei Nenkin), you join the National Pension, whether or not you are a student or a foreign national. (Some people on "Designated Activities" for medical stay or long tourist stay cannot join; to be checked.) Register at the ward office. Students can apply for the Student Payment Deferment, which postpones the premium while you study.

text.en: If you leave a job: within 14 days from the day after. For other cases (arriving from abroad, turning 20), ask at the counter (to be checked).

text.en: Bring: the application form (National Pension insured-person notification). A document showing your basic pension number, or your My Number Card. Without the card: a document showing your My Number plus ID (driver's licence, passport, residence card, etc.). The insured person or the head of household files.

text.en: People on "Designated Activities" for medical stay or long tourist stay cannot join. They file an "exemption notice" at a pension office, with copies of the residence card and the designation document. Whether the pension office is the only place: ask (to be checked).

text.en: Student Payment Deferment: students can apply to postpone the premium while studying. It is for students whose income last year was at or below a limit; family income does not count (check the limit with the Japan Pension Service).

text.en: Eligible schools include universities, junior colleges, specialised training colleges and miscellaneous-type schools. For miscellaneous-type schools, only courses of one year or longer count, and private ones must be approved by the prefectural governor. Whether your school (for example a Japanese-language school) qualifies: ask your school or the counter (to be checked).

text.en: Where to apply for the Student Payment Deferment: the National Pension counter of your ward office, a pension office, or your school (only if the school handles it). Mail is also possible. Bring a certificate of enrolment (original) or a copy of your student ID (not needed if you show it in person at the ward office). Without a My Number Card, also bring a document showing your My Number and ID (to be checked).

text.en: The Student Payment Deferment is reviewed for April to March periods. You can apply back for periods whose payment deadline passed less than 2 years ago. If you apply late, you may not receive the Disability Basic Pension for an accident or illness before the application date.
